transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you all know, Weld Cell 4 went down this morning after the coolant-system alarm activated during production of those 480 chassis brackets. The external surfaces look normal and the visual inspection didn't turn up any obvious weld defects, but that's not enough for me to authorize a restart. Per our restart procedure, I need to conduct a pre-restart check-in with both Quality and Maintenance before I can make a decision on whether this cell goes back online. So let's get started -- I need to hear from Maintenance on what caused that coolant alarm and whether the system is safe to run, and I need to hear from Quality on whether we have any concerns about the brackets that were in progress when the alarm triggered. What are we seeing?

transcript.text: Mara, I need to flag a serious quality concern before we go any further.
